profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Back End Software engineer with experience in big data on distributed platforms (Spark, EMR, dataproc). 10 years of experience in ad tech. Looking for growth and challenges.

Recent Major Projects:
Pixel Tag Server - A global deployment of edge servers to serve ad tracking pixels with single digit millisecond and 99.99% uptime SLA with over 1 billion requests and 2TB of data per day
Async Attribution - Coalesce 50+ TB of tracking data daily, from S2S files to real time pixel logs and individually attribute the most impactful engagements to conversions
Overlay - Summarize user attributes by audience and campaign with unique counts, reducing trillions of rows of table joins to actionable reports
Turbine Framework - Complete overhaul of ad data ingestion to catalog all inputs chronologically, allowing cumulative reports to run multiple times a day and reducing production incidents

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Edges Team - Software Engineer III (2020-2024)

Maintained a globally distributed ad tracking system, with single digit millisecond and 99.99% uptime SLA servicing over 10 billion requests and generating 2TB of data per day
Updated a legacy cookie based advertising tag server system to support robust and durable user tracking, in order to maintain user data value for advertisers in a future without tracking cookies
Architected and lead development of the migration of the edge system from AWS to GCP, saving tens of thousands of dollars per year in cloud service costs

Data Pipeline Team - Software Engineer III (2016-2020)

Completely overhauled ad data ingestion system into a scalable data warehouse solution, enabling reports to be run for customers in multiple time zones while reducing production incidents
Developed Spark EMR jobs in AWS to transform 50+ TB of data into daily customer facing reports
Served as the team Scrum Master, leading daily stand-ups and sprint planning meetings, resolving cross team dependencies and coordinating with overseas developers
Provided around the clock on-call support to ensure system availability and throughput

Audience Team - Software Engineer II (2014-2016)

Refactored a monolithic legacy advertising analytics dashboard into a MVC architecture, to improve performance, maintainability, and speed of future development
Worked with product managers and across teams to scope, schedule, and deliver on project milestones

Technology used: Java, Hibernate, JUnit, AWS (EMR, EC2, Redshift, RDS, SQS, Lambda), GCP, Terraform, Airflow, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
positions.insights: Skills: Version Control · Interpersonal Communication · Java · Scalability · SQL · Engineering · Apache Spark · Platform Architecture · Software Architecture · Software Infrastructure · Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) · Big Data · Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Implemented and maintained a Java services layer that surfaced data for millions of SKUs to be queried
Integrated services into frontend websites using Thrift interfaces and launched two websites in Ruby
Technology used: Java/JSP, Ruby on Rails, Thrift, Oracle, MySQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Maintained and updated middleware SDK code which provided online features to hundreds of games
Maintained scalable servers that serviced millions of requests per day
Supported customers in implementing online features from conception to certification
Updated and maintained GameSpy’s web portal
Brainstormed and rapidly prototyped new potential products
Technology used: C, C#, .NET

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote and maintained Java code to track, aggregate and analyze large volumes of user behavior data
Maintained and implemented front facing UI features in JSP based on the user behavior data
Completely overhauled the design of the second largest comparison shopping website on the internet

Technology used: Java/JSP, Oracle SQL, MySQL

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
*  Updated and improved the functionality of TextDigger’s extensive toolset, licensed from CNET
    * Created web page based search pages to organize, display and modify MySQL table entries

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented Fast Filtered Sampling (FFS) and Modulated Packet Sampling (MPS) filters in C/C++ for integration with Sprint’s Constant Monitoring (CMON) software

Designed modules for use in filtering, monitoring and reporting IP packet data received from Sprint’s internet backbone servers

Tested and evaluated effectiveness of algorithms on live internet traffic
